memberdef.argsstring: (AArch64PostLegalizerLowering, DEBUG_TYPE, "Lower AArch64 MachineInstrs after legalization", false, false) INITIALIZE_PASS_END(AArch64PostLegalizerLowering
memberdef.name: INITIALIZE_PASS_BEGIN

detaileddescription.para: This is used to offload pattern matching from the selector.
For example, this combiner will notice that a G_SHUFFLE_VECTOR is actually a G_ZIP, G_UZP, etc.
General optimization combines should be handled by either the AArch64PostLegalizerCombiner or the AArch64PreLegalizerCombiner.
